blocks.text: Mastering Chrome navigation for policy work

Efficiency starts with how you move through your browser. Most analysts rely on the mouse, but keyboard shortcuts are faster. Use ⌘ + T to open a new tab instantly. Use ⌘ + L to jump to the address bar. If you have many tabs open, use ⌘ + 1 through ⌘ + 8 to jump to the first eight tabs. Use ⌘ + 9 to jump to the last tab.
Using Lazur to assist your research

Lazur is a voice assistant for macOS that helps you stay in your flow. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about anything on your screen. If you are reading a long policy document in Chrome, ask Lazur to summarize a section or explain a term. Lazur does not click buttons for you, but it can point at elements or guide you through complex menus.

Policy research often requires keeping multiple projects separate. Use Chrome Profiles to keep personal and work browsing apart. Go to the Profile icon in the top right, then select Add. Each profile keeps its own history and bookmarks. For active research, right click a tab and select Add tab to new group. This keeps your workspace clean.
Practical Chrome tips for daily tasks

items: Clear site data for one website in Chrome when a page stops loading properly.
Install extensions to block trackers or manage citations, but remove unused ones to keep Chrome fast.
Use ⌘ + ⇧ + T to reopen a tab you closed by accident.
Add frequently used legislative portals to your Dock for faster access.

blocks.text: Analysts handle sensitive data. Regularly clear browsing data in Chrome to maintain privacy. Go to Chrome > Clear Browsing Data or use ⌘ + ⇧ + Delete. You can choose to clear only the last hour or all time. If a specific site causes issues, use the site settings to clear data for that domain only.
Why Lazur fits the policy analyst workflow

You do not want to stop writing a report to look for a setting. Hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur where a setting is. It will draw a circle around the menu item. Use the dictation feature by holding fn to write your notes or drafts directly into your browser-based tools. It is fast and keeps your hands on the keyboard.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with all Chrome versions?
faq.answer: Lazur works on macOS 13 or later, which supports the current versions of Chrome. It does not require a specific Chrome version.

faq.question: Can Lazur edit my documents in Chrome?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or edit files. It helps you find things and dictates text.

faq.question: Is my research data private when using Lazur?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur only sees your screen while you hold the shortcut. Data is not stored or used to train models.
